content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently underestimate prices in early 2024, indicating a lag in capturing market sentiment shifts.", "Sentiment signals with negative values correlate with sharp price drops, suggesting model overconfidence in bullish forecasts.", "Models exhibit mean-reversion bias when sentiment is neutral or negative, leading to premature price corrections.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment aligns with recent price trends, indicating sentiment-driven calibration is critical.", "Overshoots occur when sentiment is strongly bullish and models fail to account for regulatory or supply-side shocks.", "Models underperform during periods of high volatility, especially when sentiment is mixed or rapidly changing.", "Forecast bias is most pronounced in the first 10 days of the 30-day window, suggesting delayed reaction to sentiment changes."]}
